parsed_json.up: Select distinct compound ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human Cytochrome P450 2C9. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering by target name 'Cytochrome P450 2C9' and organism 'Homo sapiens'. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Sort by compound ChEMBL ID.
